SELECT ca.campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
JOIN coupons co ON co.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = co.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id
ORDER BY ca.campaign_id
LIMIT 1000;
